name: denesens-monorepo
description: Denesens Solutions Corporate Monorepo - Luxury Tech Website & Backend API

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run seed
